Banana Chocolate Chip Muffin Recipe
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 1, 2009 - 11:41pm

Ingredients




8 cups All Purpose Flour
1 tablespoon Baking Powder
1 1/2 teaspoons Baking Soda
1 1/2 teaspoons Kosher Salt
1 pound Unsalted Butter
2 cups Brown Sugar
8 cups Mashed Bananas
8 lrg Eggs
 cups Vit. D Milk
1 tablespoon Real Vanilla
3 cups Chocolate Chips
3 cups Walnuts

Preparation

1 This recipe is a Yield of 48 each Muffins Wow! Recipe Origanated: 2 1. Scale/Measure all ingredients. 3 2. Sift the dry & mix together in a large bowl.(including sugar) 4 3. Cut in the Fat (butter) until it resembles a coarse cornmeal. 5 4. In another bowl combine all wet ingredients. (including eggs) 6 5. add all wet to the dry, Mix JUST UNTIL INCORPARATED! 7 6. place in muffin tin, 1/2-3/4 way up each tin. 8 Bake at 375* 9 Yummy...Yummy Please note that you can cut the recipe in half with no problem, I have never cut in by 1/4.
